synopsis: ISO 19206-4:2020 specifies the bicyclist target, while ISO 19206-2:2018 specifies the pedestrian dummy [f15324]. Euro NCAP protocols reference both Parts 2 and 4, and Chapter 3 specifically identifies ISO 19206-4:2020 as the standard followed by the Euro NCAP 2026–2028 bicyclist target [f13500, f2547]. The glossary states that these targets are used by both UN R131 and Euro NCAP’s consumer rating program; all three facts concern on-road applications and do not establish acceptance criteria for heavy off-road machines [f15324, f13500, f2547].

relations.note: Identifies the Part 4 edition, target type, and Euro NCAP program years.
Maps each part to its target and adds UN R131 usage.
Dates Euro NCAP’s use of the ISO 19206-4:2020 bicyclist target to 2026–2028.
